segments.say: Everyone knows the four move checkmate. But what if Black does it to you?
segments.caption: BLACK DOES IT TO YOU

segments.say: White starts normal. King pawn. Black copies.
segments.caption: Looks normal...

segments.say: Bishop to c4. Black copies again. Now both bishops are staring at the weak f pawns.
segments.caption: Eyes on f2

segments.say: White plays d3. And Black's queen jumps straight to h4.
segments.caption: Queen out early?!

segments.say: White attacks the queen with the knight. Feeling very smart.
segments.caption: Big brain move?

segments.say: Queen takes f2. Checkmate. In four moves.
segments.caption: Game over in 4

segments.say: Would you have fallen for this? Comment below, and follow for a new trap every day.
segments.caption: Would YOU fall for it?
